About Us

Ultimats is a market leader in the floor mat industry in India with worldwide exports.

We are driven by a passion for innovation, new techniques and materials. Through this dedication, we craft unique and functional bespoke matting solutions that mesmerize while creating a perfect balance of aesthetics, performance and durability.

Our manufactured product range comprises of commercial customized matting, barrier matting, rental floormats carpet mats and aluminium inlay heavy-traffic matting for varied interior and exterior applications.

We are committed to growing with our partners by providing the best matting solution, highest quality and the fastest delivery to the end-user customer. This commitment is the reason why we are by far the #1 Mat Company in the Indian Sub-Continent.

Backed with a strong national network and a large reseller base internationally, our diversified operations are seamlessly integrated right from product manufacturing to organized retail to providing high quality end-customer service.

Our high business ethics, reliability of our products and services and respect for people have contributed towards building our good corporate image in the industry.

"To offer innovative, functional and customized mat products that exceed our customers’ expectations in quality, performance and cost through development of new products and continuous improvement of existing ones."

At Ultimate, we are committed to our corporate vision of acting responsibly for the long term in how we conduct our business operations to help meet our ambition of being the best matting company in India.

With the aim of building a harmonious ecosystem, we invest significantly to ensure that the environmental impact of our business is minimal. We believe that being a responsible manufacturer-exporter means respecting the interests of all our stakeholders.

We are determined to contribute to the communities in which we operate, and we aim to build long-term relationships with local groups.

We are equally committed to our policy of reducing our carbon footprint and promoting sustainability.

In summary, our CSR policies reflect our senior management's overall commitment to high standards of integrity and ethical conduct.
